placeArmAt: Click a spot on the image to place the anchor of part {{n}}
placeArmB: Click a spot on the image to place the number badge of part {{n}}
placeNew: Click a spot on the image to add a part
hintArmAt: Click on the image to place the anchor of part {{n}}.
hintArmB: Click on the image to place the number badge of part {{n}}.
hintNew: Click on the image to add a part (the anchor goes where you click, the number badge to its upper left; you can move them later).
eyebrow: Small English text above the title
label: Title
partsHint: Numbers match the drawing on the left and the parts list on the site. Check "Hidden" for parts you don't need; the numbers after it move up. A part without a name shows the faint code in its box.
name: Name
uploadField: Upload image · white line art on a transparent background works best (it's drawn on the dark cargo bay)
telemetry: Show live telemetry above the parts list (temperature, load, memory, power)
bayOnHint: When off, the bay is still drawn on the shuttle, it just can't be opened.
labelHint: Also the bay's tag on the shuttle.
sheetHint: To light up a whole part on hover, or draw your own network lines and signal rings, put a sheet pack in custom/setup/ (see the README there). After a rebuild it shows up in this menu.
extraHint: Listed in the parts list only, numbered "·": fans, cables, things plugged in.
telemetryHint: The numbers come from the machine this site runs on, so put it on that server's bay.
devicesHint: For example the services running on this machine or the devices connected to it. Each one can link to posts about it.
appliancesHint: One line at the end of the list: "Other connected appliances: brand type · brand type".
recordsHint: Listed at the bottom under "Notes about this machine".
baseOnHint: The old satellite on the distant orbit. When off it's still drawn, it just can't be opened.
baseLabelHint: Also the tag next to the satellite. The small text above the title is always "BASE II".
specsHint: Matched in order to the numbers on the satellite drawing, up to {{max}}. Each line ends with "…OK" on the site.
